sentences.text: David Arquette -LRB- born September 8 , 1971 -RRB- is an American actor , film director , producer , screenwriter , fashion designer and former professional wrestler .

A member of the Arquette acting family , he first became known during the mid-1990s after starring in several Hollywood films , such as the Scream series , Wild Bill , Buffy the Vampire Slayer , See Spot Run and Eight Legged Freaks .
